description: This file contains the implementation of a translation service using a PiTranslator struct that interacts with an external client for language translation, including retry logic, placeholder masking, and prompt handling.

classes.name: PiTranslator
classes.description: Struct responsible for managing translation operations via an external client with retry and masking support.

methods.name: NewPiTranslator
methods.description: Constructor function to initialize a new PiTranslator with source and target languages, glossary, and thinking configuration.

methods.name: Translate
methods.description: Translates text with masking, using internal translate method.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Internal method implementing translation logic with retries, masking, and unmasking.

methods.name: translateWithRetry
methods.description: Retries translation attempts with exponential backoff for retryable errors.

methods.name: translateMasked
methods.description: Performs masked translation by replacing placeholders and validating the result.

methods.name: translateRaw
methods.description: Performs raw translation by sending text directly to client.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the PiTranslator client, releasing resources.
